decisions.reason: The source sets the K marking color to beige; it does not change the existing green accents, beige body, or support-base colors.
The beige instruction applies to the K on each dispense button, not the support-base logo, lettering, or font color.
Changing the decorative K marking color does not alter button-actuated dispensing behavior, flow, or control mechanics.
The source changes a specific button marking color without changing the broader DJ-turntable visual theme.
The instruction concerns K markings on dispense buttons and does not change placard text, position, or orientation.
The source refers to markings on the dispense buttons, not the master power control or its location.
The beige K marking does not change the placement of speed, dispense, or master power controls.
Button marking color has no effect on bowl dimensions, capacity, or geometry.
The source does not change enclosure thickness, size, or mechanical form factor.
The source changes only the K marking color and does not affect spout geometry, material, or orientation.
The beige marking instruction does not change the established removable-spout cleaning method.
The K marking color does not change the platform configuration, dimensions, or cup-clearance purpose.
